en: A vintage multi-view postcard with sepia photographs showing a panoramic view of Tolmin and a couple of notable buildings, plus a small vignette of a hill or forest hut. The front bears the caption in Slovene 'Pozdrav iz Tolmina.' The reverse is a bilingual Austro‑Hungarian correspondence card ('Correspondenz-Karte. Dopisnica.') addressed in black ink, with an Austrian stamp and circular postmarks.
